body:
WHAT
If the user sends a message while a turn is running, the frontend sends steer_message. The engine queues the text and injects it as a user message at the running turn's next message boundary (before the next model call, or instead of ending the turn), wrapped in a reminder saying the user is steering mid-run. Steering re-arms the self-verify rung and resets the stall detector's spent pivots. If the turn has already ended, the text is run as a normal user turn.

WHY
Without it the user must wait for the turn to end or interrupt and lose work to correct course; without re-arming, the turn could end on old evidence without checking the new instruction.

WHERE
engine/core/src/runtime/engine.ts — Engine.send() case 'steer_message' (describes images, then `if (this.session.isBusy()) this.session.steer(text); else … runTurn(text)`). engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — Session.steer() (pushes to pendingSteering, emits '⚡ steering' command_output), Session.runTurn() drainSteering() closure (resets selfVerifyFired, pivotCount, identicalRounds, lastRoundSig; pushes '<system-reminder>The user adds, mid-run…' message) called before every streamAssistantTurn and when toolCalls.length === 0 before any end-of-turn rung.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. With a FakeProvider scripted as [tool call, end_turn text, end_turn text], calling session.steer('also add tests') while the tool executes results in the second provider request's last user message containing 'The user adds, mid-run' followed by 'also add tests'.
2. Steering queued when the model returns a no-tool end_turn is not dropped: the turn does not end, a third request is made containing the steer text, and turn_finished fires only after it.
3. Engine.send({type:'steer_message', text}) while session.isBusy() is false starts a normal runTurn whose first user message is exactly the text with no steering reminder.
4. In OVERDRIVE with a self-verify already fired (DONE answered once), a steer before the next clean end causes a second self-verify request in the same turn (selfVerifyFired was reset).
5. After two forced pivots, a steer resets pivotCount so the next stall triggers STALL_PIVOT_TEXT again rather than STALL_ASK_TEXT.
